_about: Source geometry for the test grove at the Farmington Bird Refuge (George S. and Dolores Doré Eccles Wildlife Education Center, Farmington, UT). Trail points and Frags 1–7 supplied by JoJo on 2026-11-19 from Google Maps. Every coordinate in seed.sql and apps/mobile/e2e/demo-route.gpx derives from this file. Edit here, then regenerate. Coordinates are [lat, lng] (WGS84); GeoJSON/PostGIS use [lng, lat], so the generator must swap them.
_shape_note: UNCONFIRMED: the points look like a lollipop: a stem P1 → P2 → P3, then a loop P3 → P4 … P11 → P3. The segment P11 → P1 would cross the trail at P3. Treat the trail path as P1,P2,P3,P4,P5,P6,P7,P8,P9,P10,P11,P3,P2,P1 until JoJo confirms.

grove.boundary_rule: ST_Buffer(ST_ConvexHull(all trail points + all fragment points)::geography, 50): a simple polygon covering the buildings, the trail and the marsh inside the loop. No holes.

second_grove.boundary_rule: ST_Translate(Farmington grove_boundary, ~300 m east in longitude at this latitude).

fragments.name: Beginning
fragments.note: Day + Night revision versions in seed (same narration asset).

fragments.name: Parking Lot 1
fragments.note: Revision 2 is a Story Correction (stable UUID …00004b).

fragments.name: Ending
fragments.note: same point as frag1; never competes with it (frag1 must precede)

fragments.name: Heron Overlook
fragments.note: A25: standard fragment with Day-only revision_version in seed (no night row).

fragments.name: Hidden Post
fragments.note: Physical play via marker; packs include coords + marker hash (no raw marker_code).

fragments.name: Two Ways
fragments.note: OR test. Revision 2 is a Story Contingency (replaces M2 crossroads outcome gate).

_fragment_spacing: Radii are 10.67 m (35 ft default). Pairs at 0 m or with ordering constraints are exempt from overlap warnings; frag3/frag4 remain a plausible RADIUS_OVERLAP case at ~37 m.

zones.ambience_marsh: same polygon as the grove boundary (profile: marsh)
zones.music_zone: the part of the grove boundary east of longitude -111.9235 (between P11 and P10), clipped to the boundary. The walk crosses its edge twice.

gpx._start_note: about 100 m west of frag1, outside the boundary buffer, so the route enters the grove and the ambience zone
gpx.route: start → frag1 → frag2 → frag4 → frag3 → frag5 → frag6 (frag1's point) → trail P2 → P3 → frag7 (≈P11) → P10 → chord to P8 (passes ~75 m from frag9) → frag8 (P7) → P6 → P5 → frag10 (P4) → P3 → P2 → P1 → start
gpx.pace: 1.4 m/s: one point per second, 1.4 m apart
gpx.dwell: at each fragment, stand still (repeat the same point each second) for its revision-1 narration duration_ms (from supabase/seed-media.json) + 5 s
gpx.never: do not auto-trigger frag9 proximity (physical marker only)

prerequisite_semantics: ADR 0004: requires is a list of groups; ALL groups must be satisfied; a group is satisfied when ANY member has been completed. Cross-grove members resolve via externalPrerequisites when the other grove pack is installed.
